update.name: slider_even_speed_change
update.construction: z + A a, A = (B^T B + xi U^T U)^+ B^T H: normal velocity h, even relative speed change; no refit
update.coordinates: real Fourier coefficients of normal distance h (m) in normalized arclength
update.gauge: none: keeps the existing speed unevenness; no refit
update.samples: 32K points uniform in t, arclength weights J 2pi/Q
update.solve: pseudo-inverse of the normal equations (numpy lstsq, default rcond)
update.validity: coefficient area, sampled minimum speed and segment intersections
